title: Research: Claude Code's beta tracing, inbound TRACEPARENT in -p sessions and OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES on every point and event are kb facts
goal: kb/public/claude/otel-monitoring.md gains DOC facts with source rows (code.claude.com/docs/en/monitoring-usage and env-vars) on: the variables that turn tracing on (CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY, CLAUDE_CODE_ENHANCED_TELEMETRY_BETA, OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER and the per-signal endpoint and protocol) and that it is beta; the span hierarchy (claude_code.interaction, llm_request, tool, hook) and its status rules; that -p and Agent SDK sessions read TRACEPARENT and TRACESTATE from their environment and parent claude_code.interaction under it while interactive sessions ignore it, with the parent.source attribute; that event records carry that trace_id and span_id without a traces exporter; that Bash subprocesses inherit TRACEPARENT and CLAUDE_CODE_PROPAGATE_TRACEPARENT; and that OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES keys go on every metric point and event (OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES) with percent-encoded values; each fact keeps the Claude Code version the page names

run:
import subprocess, sys
ART = 'kb/public/claude/otel-monitoring.md'
CASES = [('Does a claude -p session read TRACEPARENT from its environment and parent its spans under it?', ['TRACEPARENT', '-p']), ("Which variables turn on Claude Code's distributed tracing?", ['CLAUDE_CODE_ENHANCED_TELEMETRY_BETA', 'OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER']), ('Are OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES keys added to every Claude Code metric datapoint and event?', ['OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES', 'OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES'])]
miss = []
for q, terms in CASES:
    out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/rag.py', 'pack', q, '--root', 'public', '--budget', '2500'],
                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    hit = [l for l in out.splitlines() if l.startswith('- ' + ART[len('kb/'):] + ':') and '[DOC' in l
           and all(t.lower() in l.lower() for t in terms)]
    if not hit:
        miss.append((q, terms))
print('missing:', miss if miss else 'none')
sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)
